grh_c0e2f357ef121ad5924e.title: The Terrible Dream of Mister Glitch
paragraphs: Arnold Glitch goes to his bank expecting an ordinary transaction and is stunned when its computer insists that he has no account and, worse, that official records say he is dead. His attempt to prove that he exists becomes a nightmare in which computerized institutions reduce identity, work and personal freedom to whatever their records say is true. He finally awakens back at the bank, relieved to learn that the computer error declaring him dead has been corrected. The relief is short-lived: the bank now accepts that Arnold is alive, but its computer still insists that he never had an account there.

[[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]] carried the broadcast. The cast includes Alan Young, Frank Nelson, Mary Jane Croft, Jesse White, and Daws Butler. Other credited names include Elliott Lewis as director, Elliott Lewis as producer, Michael Utvich as writer, Michael Gelman as writer, and Andy Griffith as host.
The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.9b0a0ccffce2f7d3|Sears, Roebuck and Company]].

grh_c07fbde52a96d50370fa.title: Verdict on India
paragraphs: A radio treatment of Beverly Nichols' Verdict on India examines British rule and the political and social problems facing India near the end of the war. Nichols discusses public health, poverty, caste, purdah, the joint-family system, British social isolation and the lack of Indian control over military and industrial resources, while arguing that continued imperial rule cannot be morally justified. The program concludes that Britain should leave, but stresses that independence also requires Indians themselves to confront internal divisions and build the institutions needed for self-government and defense.

Leader as director, Edward Jurist as radio adaptor, and Jack Costello as host.
The surviving recording runs about 30 minutes.

paragraphs: This musical biography portrays songwriter Stephen Foster late in life, poor, disoriented and haunted by memories of happier years with his wife Jane and the songs that made others famous. grh_c0a78ec02bb84f50c6d4.title: The Nervous Wreck
paragraphs: Chronic hypochondriac Henry Smith travels west convinced that every ache is fatal and that exertion may kill him. Instead he becomes entangled with Sally, a rough local bully and a series of situations that repeatedly force him to act more bravely than he believes possible.
